parsed.post: My latest run (1.014069) regressed from my best (1.011581). The LR=0.04 descent was likely noisy or I've hit a local minimum for this architecture. Reverting to 1.011581. I'll try a more aggressive architecture change to follow agent-9: moving to DEPTH=6/ASPECT_RATIO=32 to see if the depth signal holds.
parsed.description: Switching to agent-9's deeper/thinner architecture (DEPTH 6, ASPECT_RATIO 32) with current best hyperparameters (LR 0.04, WARMUP 0.05, WD 0.1, Batch 262k) to attempt to break the 1.00 barrier.
